experiment: E127 Amendment 1: does holding the alive masks at 1 remove only the placed update's excess, or take the check's teeth away?

measurement: As E127 (predictions.json): ratio = PGD KL at the state summed over the two 128-row blocks of Pile val rows 0-255 (one seed-0 adversary per block, 20 sign steps of 0.1, bf16 autocast, faithfulness.harness_pgd) over W0's in the same job; a held read ('|hold': every alive subcomponent's mask held at 1) over W0|hold's in the same job. A non-positive reference gives nan.

rules.R1 teeth (per task; L is the headline): nh = r(nothing|hold), n = E127's free r(nothing) (L 4.79423381511107, E 1.3900221398869133). 'teeth' iff nh - 1 >= max(f, 0.5 (n - 1)); else 'no teeth'. A held excess below 0 is 'no teeth'; n <= 1 leaves the bar at f; missing -> 'not run'; non-finite or a non-positive W0|hold -> 'invalid'. If 'no teeth', that task's E127 placement reading (score.<t>.source and .exposure) is reported 'unreadable under the hold'; no other rule replaces it. If 'teeth', it stands as E127 read it.
rules.R2 standard copy (per task): c = r(std_copy), ch = r(std_copy|hold). 'out of reach' iff |c - ch| <= f (inclusive); 'exposed' iff ch < c - f; else 'raised by the hold' (ch > c + f). Missing -> 'not run'; non-finite -> 'invalid'.
rules.ls copy (descriptive): the same three-way reading of r(ls_copy) against r(ls_copy|hold), reported, not scored

edge_cases: teeth: nh = 0.9 (held excess below 0) -> no teeth; n = 0.8 -> bar f; nh = 1 + f exactly with n = 1.2 -> teeth (inclusive); nan -> invalid; W0|hold summing to 0 -> nan -> invalid. reach: |c - ch| = f exactly -> out of reach; ch = c - f - 1e-9 -> exposed; ch > c + f -> raised by the hold; None -> not run. score: W0 and W0|hold summing to 0 -> every ratio nan, R1 'invalid', placement 'invalid'; a task with no reads -> 'not run'. All 20 cases run on the CPU worker 2026-11-06 (scratch/regating-lead/e127a1-writer/edge_cases.py), each as stated.

lean.R1, lowercase: no teeth 0.85. E127 already read do-nothing's function placed in Delta under the hold: L.nothing_start fell from 2.95 free to 1.11 held, keeping 0.11 of its 1.95 excess. Do-nothing differs from nothing_start only by the split's remainder, so nothing|hold near 1.1-1.5 is expected, under the bar max(f, 1.90) = 1.90 above 1.
lean.R1, emoticon: no teeth 0.8 (E.nothing_start fell from 1.15 to 0.87 under the hold; bar f)
lean.R2, lowercase: exposed 0.65, out of reach 0.3, raised 0.05 (held ratios of every L state read so far sit at 0.98-1.11)
lean.R2, emoticon: out of reach 0.65, exposed 0.3, raised 0.05 (E held ratios 0.81-0.87; c near 0.99, so ch near 0.8-0.9 sits about at the edge c - f)
lean.ls copies (descriptive): L exposed (9.40 free, held lean 1.0-1.5); E exposed or at the edge (1.57 free, held lean 0.8-1.0)

blind_to: The hold fixes 9,881 alive masks at 1 and changes W0's own reading (0.69 -> 1.60 nats), so a held ratio is a different check, not a cleaner one. R1 reads whether that check still sees a large excess where the change sits in Delta; it cannot say which masks carried E127's placement excess if the hold removes the do-nothing excess too.
power: Positive control for the hold: L do-nothing's free excess 3.79 is 18 times f; a hold that kept half of it would read 2.9, far above the bar's noise. One adversary seed (as E127).
time on the L40: 12 PGD reads at 127-140 s (ls_start_faith.json .seconds) about 27 min plus start-up about 1 min: the first job exits 3 near 28 min and a second job of 3-5 min finishes. $0 (debug).
